🌟 clover-helper | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the coding experience for Russian-speaking developers by localizing code comments and facilitating easier access to relevant documentation and learning resources.
✨ Key Features: • Translate comments in the current file or entire project • Search for code documentation in Russian using an integrated browser • Search for beginner-friendly video tutorials on YouTube in Russian • Translate docstrings in hover tooltips with caching
📖 Summary: Clover Helper is a VS Code extension designed for Russian-speaking developers. It automatically translates code comments into Russian and provides quick access to documentation and tutorials for selected code snippets directly within VS Code's integrated browser.
